cases.refreshed: Infant and Toddler Storytime invites children and their caregivers to wiggle, rhyme, and sing with diverse books, songs, and fingerplays that encourage language, play, and exploration. This program is geared for children 0 to 3 years of age and their parents/caregivers, but all children are welcome! After Storytime concludes, we invite you to Stay & Play! The storytime librarian will be on the Children's Room floor with special toys until 12 PM. Meet new friends, play with toys, chat, get book recommendations, and maybe even create something! Storytime: 11:00-11:30 AM; Stay & Play: 11:30 AM-12:00 PM. This program is developed to align with the Early Education Quality Standards.

cases.refreshed: Join your community to help beautify your Pearl Avenue Branch Library! Register to take part in this opportunity to Volunteer Away Your Fines at a rate of $20 per hour. This is a perfect opportunity for anyone interested in volunteering away their library fines, gaining service hours for school or work, or just giving back to the community. This event will be happening at the Pearl Avenue Branch Library only. Arrive on time to sign in at the information desk. A signed waiver is required. A parent must sign for anyone under 18. Anyone under 15 must volunteer with a parent or guardian. Volunteers must commit to the full session (3:30 PM - 4:30 PM). No experience or special skills are necessary. Training and supplies are provided. For more information, email pamail@sjlibrary.org or call 408-808-3053.
